checks.placeholders: The English source takes no interpolation arguments; this locale declares none either, so placeholder parity is 0 = 0.
checks.unicode: NFC verified; no bidi control characters; no NBSP; no double or edge spaces.
checks.structure: Two sentences in the target, as the sidecar's length field asks, with the two candidate reasons in the second.
checks.meaning: Both reasons present, neither disclosed, no assertion of nonexistence. ن ہوں and کر دیا گیا ہو are the right subjunctive forms after ہو سکتا ہے.
checks.register: آپ / آپ کے, matching the namespace and the ur guide's ban on تم/تو.
checks.terminology: رکن = member.count and members.role.member. آرکائیو = ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.plain.
checks.punctuation: Two Urdu ۔ terminators; Arabic script only, no Devanagari, no Latin characters, no bidi control characters, no space before punctuation.
checks.method: Read against the English value and the sidecar, then against members.role.member / member.count (رکن), ui.teamBridge.archive.banner.plain ('یہ چینل آرکائیو کیا گیا ہے۔') and members.read_only (آپ register).
checks.sidecar: The English sidecar entry was read in full and each target was checked against its four requirements individually rather than against the English wording: the reader is told they cannot open this conversation, both possible reasons are offered, which one it is stays unrevealed, and nothing suggests the conversation does not exist.
